subject: To use an external created mesh from another package

messages.author: ef564d903de9fe71
messages.subject: To use an external created mesh from another package
parts:
Dear INLA developers, 

Hi,

I want to do a 3-D spatial geostatistics analysis by using INLA-SPDE. My question is: how can we use an external created mesh from another R package like tetramesh or alphahape3d in INLA package? Is that possible? I can get a matrix as an output....

Thanks in advance,
Hossein

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] To use an external created mesh from another package
parts:
Hi,

3D fields in that way is not supported, only 2D x time.

I don't know if Finn have any plans in this direction...

H

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] To use an external created mesh from another package
parts:
Hi,
As long as you can compute the FEM structure matrices C and G (in our notation), and map your observations to barycentric tetrahedral coordinates from your external mesh, you can either do it via rgeneric, or use the more low level inla functions to construct an inla spde object that can be used. Contact me off-list if that’s of interest.

Finn
